menu_options.panel: Panel (a tablet that could not be discovered)

controller.title: Configure the media controller
controller.description: Select the Music Assistant player. The {profile} drives up to {slot_count} room controls. Leave a slot empty to hide that tile. Labels are optional and fall back to the entity name.

panel.title: Add a panel
panel.description: A panel normally appears on its own once it announces itself on the network. Add it by hand only when it cannot. The panel ID must match the one the device announces; a panel writes its own to panel-id on first run.

pair.title: Pair the panel
pair.description: {name} is showing a six-digit code on its screen. Type it here first: Home Assistant hands the panel an access token of its own, and nothing else is asked until the panel has answered. Nothing has to be typed on the tablet.

controller_link.title: Media controller
controller_link.description: {name} is paired. It is a {profile} and drives up to {slot_count} room controls. Choose the media controller it should play from.

slots.title: Room controls
slots.description: {name} is paired and is a {profile} driving up to {slot_count} room controls. Leave a slot empty to hide that tile. Labels are optional and fall back to the entity name.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair the panel again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} is asking for a new access token, which happens after the tablet is wiped. Type the code it is showing. Its room controls and entity IDs stay as they are; only the token is replaced.

error.not_music_assistant: Select a media player provided by Music Assistant.
error.invalid_code: The pairing code is six digits.
error.token_failed: Home Assistant could not create an access token for this panel. Check the log.
error.code_mismatch: The panel is showing a different code. Read the six digits off the tablet again.
error.pairing_timeout: The panel did not answer. Check that it is on, on the same network, and still showing a pairing code.

abort.reauth_successful: The panel will pick up its new token within a few seconds.
abort.no_controller: Add a media controller first: this panel has to play from one.
abort.no_panel_id: The panel did not announce an identifier and cannot be added automatically.

progress.waiting_for_panel: Waiting for {name} to answer with that code. Leave the tablet on its pairing screen.

init.title: Controller options
init.description: Remap the player or the room controls of the {profile}, which drives up to {slot_count} of them. The integration reloads automatically.

slots.title: Panel options
slots.description: Choose what {name} plays from and remap its room controls. It is a {profile} driving up to {slot_count} of them. Leave a slot empty to hide that tile. Labels are optional and fall back to the entity name. The panel keeps its token and its entity IDs.

error.not_music_assistant: Select a media player provided by Music Assistant.
error.already_configured: This Music Assistant player is already used by another controller.

refresh.name: Refresh controller data
refresh.description: Refresh queue and playlist data immediately.

play_queue_item.name: Play queue item
play_queue_item.description: Start a Music Assistant queue item without replacing the queue.
